scope: Additive Healing Tome L1-18 Grand Warden active healing audit for standard Home Village combat.
game_version: Official December 2023 Equipment release; September 2024 balance account; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Healing Tome is Common active Grand Warden Equipment unlocked at Blacksmith level 6.
It heals the Grand Warden and nearby friendly units; Warden receives HP recovery and HP increase bonuses.
sources.limitations: Does not give the radius, eligible classes, heal cadence, per-level rate, duration or activation order.

sources.title: September Update: Full Patch Notes
facts: Supercell states that the September balance changes went live and links to the detailed notice.
sources.limitations: This page does not itself enumerate Healing Tome duration values; the linked detailed notice does not expose a machine-readable level table in the checked page.

sources.title: Home Village Balance Changes - September 2024
facts: The dated report records September 2024 Healing Tome duration reductions, including L1-2 from 16 to 15 seconds and L18 from 25 to 20 seconds.
sources.limitations: Historical balance information does not prove current 2026 duration continuity or supply pulse timing and geometry.

sources.title: Healing Tome — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table confirms L1-18 Warden HP increase 92-685 and upgrade costs matching pinned raw fields.
The page repeats that Warden and nearby friendly units receive healing.
sources.limitations: It does not list current healing per second, duration, Warden recovery or pulse/targeting mechanics.

sources.title: Pinned Healing Tome Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned L1-18 payload has healingPerSecond 60-150, abilityDuration 15-20 seconds, Warden hitpointIncrease 92-685 and hpRecoveryIncrease 165-863.
sources.limitations: The rate is labelled per second but the payload does not define integer pulse interval, carryover, aura entry/exit or current effect continuity.

observations.note: Durations are exact 10 ms multiples; a per-second heal rate cannot be divided into invented 10 ms heals without a sourced pulse/rounding contract.

derivations.result: Retain pinned heal rate, duration and Warden bonuses as catalogue data
derivations.method: Convert duration strings to integer milliseconds for audit only, compare Warden HP and ore fields with the dated table, and keep effect timing unimplemented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal every entity by healingPerSecond divided by 100 each 10 ms tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The game heal pulse frequency, accumulator, rounding and first pulse phase are not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal all nearby Heroes, Pets, children and siege machines
rejected_inferences.reason: The description says nearby friendly units but gives no entity-class filters; siege machines are outside this goal.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Warden hpRecoveryIncrease as an immediate heal on activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw stat name does not define timing, cap or whether the recovery is separate from aura healing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Keep healing on a unit after it leaves the aura
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source specifies entry, exit or lingering effect semantics for Healing Tome.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use Eternal Tome aura geometry or effect ordering
rejected_inferences.reason: The two Equipment items have distinct mechanics and no sourced common radius or tick contract.

items: current L1-18 heal-rate, duration and recovery continuity
aura center, radius, boundary and eligible in-scope classes
first heal, pulse interval, integer accumulation, rounding and expiration tick
aura entry/exit, movement, heal cap, overheal, death and revival
Warden recovery timing and interaction with Life Gem, Eternal Tome, Pets and other heals
auto-activation, simultaneous damage, healing and death order
Viewer aura/control/overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Healing Tome L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official evidence establishes active Warden and nearby-unit healing, while current effect values, aura geometry and heal pulse/tick behavior remain unresolved.
